correctness.rationale: Uniform-root permutation decomposition gives independent size-conditioned subtrees. The boundary-corrected leaf expectation differs from an affine function only at sizes zero and one, giving exact root covariance \(-4(H_{n-1}-1)/(3n)\). Substituting into the total-covariance recurrence and summing an explicit rational/harmonic series proves \(\operatorname{Cov}(L_n,P_n)=-[n(n+1)-6]/(9n)\) for every sample size at least two. A local-peak indicator proof gives Var(L_n)=2(n+1)/45 for n>=4; the Quicksort exact variance identity then gives the sharp correlation prefactor. Standalone exact-rational recurrences checked sample sizes through 80; exhaustive uniform insertion permutations checked sizes two through eight (46,232 permutations). Finite checks corroborate, not replace, proof.

value.rationale: Local BST leaf count measures branching shape whereas global path length is exact comparison cost; their nontrivial dependence affects simultaneous normal/global-algorithmic observations. The finite identity supplies all boundary effects and the missing explicit leading constant in known linear covariance asymptotics, and quantifies decorrelation with an exact nonzero sharp coefficient. The root-rank decomposition reveals a structural cancellation; the same precision is not a routine marginal substitution. This is a motivated exact joint theorem without any claim of an independent audit or a broader multivariate limit law.
